Exam Date & Time: 07-May-2025 (02:30 PM - 05:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  Manipal Institute of Technology, Bengaluru  
  BTech VI Semester  
  End Semester Examination - April / May -2024  
  SOFTWARE VERIFICATION AND VALIDATION [IT-3223]  
Marks: 50                                                                           Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
1)           What makes a good software test engineer? Give the principles of software testing.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Why does software have bugs? Illustrate the reasons with an example.                    (5)  
2)           Describe the impact of engineer's soft skills for performing verification techniques.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      How defect severity and priority are determined during software testing. Provide  
  examples to justify your explanation.                                                   (5)  
  
3)           Compare software inspection with testing in terms of defect detection capabilities,  
  cost-effectiveness, and timing in the software development lifecycle. Why are  
  (5)  
  inspections considered more effective at detecting certain types of defects?  
  A)  
  B)      What is equivalence class partitioning? Design Strong normal equivalence class test  
  cases for the NextDate function assuming necessary data.                                (5)  
  
4)           Derive the boundary value test cases for the Simple Automated Teller Machine  
  assuming necessary data.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Draw the control flow graph and Compute the cyclomatic complexity for the given         (5)  
  program.
